name: CryptoCloud – Crypto Payment Gateway
author: Crypto Cloud

sections.description:
CryptoCloud is a cryptocurrency payment gateway that allows businesses worldwide to accept and process payments in the most traded digital currencies on WordPress & Woocommerce. With CryptoCloud, you can integrate crypto acquiring with online services, e-commerce stores, and other platforms.

Ready to provide:

➤ Detailed statistics;
➤ Mass payouts;
➤ Automatic withdrawals based on preferred schedule and amount;
➤ Payment via Web3 wallets, including connection through WalletConnect;
➤ Cryptocurrency exchange within the personal account;
➤ Flexible payment page customization;
➤ Automatic conversion of incoming payments into USDT;
➤ Option to use permanent wallet addresses;
➤ AML transaction checks;
➤ Support in Russian and English.

Among the available currencies are:

BTC • LTC • ETH • TRX • TON • BNB • SOL • USDT • USDC
DAI • PYSD • USDD • XAUT • ARB • OP • SHIB • PEPE • TRUMP

Several networks are available for most currencies, including Ethereum, BSC, Tron, Solana, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, and TON.
The list of supported cryptocurrencies is constantly expanding. More details about the available payment methods can be found in the relevant section.

CryptoCloud payment gateway allows you to solve several tasks:

➤ Accept international payments;
➤ Reduce online acquiring costs;
➤ Increase settlement speed;
➤ Increase payment conversion;
➤ Avoid chargebacks and bank card fraud.

Start accepting cryptocurrency now!

➤ To learn about other features, please visit our website and sign up
➤ Demo payment page
➤ Official Support
